slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
“赵老头，我知道你被王家欺负了一辈子，现在想不想报复，我能帮你！”
“我没有骗你，我就是王建国的老婆，你碰我就是报复他，明白了吗？”
“你还傻站着干什么，快点摸我啊，我都这么主动了，你一个大老爷们磨磨唧唧的干什么！”
杏花村农田地头，赵大柱呆愣愣的看着面前的李玉娇，一时间回不过神来。
他今年都五十二岁了，别说和女人干那档子事，他甚至连女人的小手都没有摸过，直到现在还是个光棍，被村里人笑话。
而眼前的李玉娇，正是杏花村村长王建国的婆娘，不到三十的她年轻貌美，皮肤白皙，一双大眼睛水灵灵的就好像会说话，粉粉嫩嫩的樱桃小嘴叫人看了就欲罢不能。
她的身材也很顶，平时出门买个菜什么的，村里的老少爷们见了她，哪个不流哈喇子？
可她现在竟然主动找上门来，对自己一个老光棍投怀送抱？
赵大柱还在发愣，而李玉娇已经等不及了，主动抓住赵大柱布满老茧的手。
光滑细腻的触感，还有那柔若无骨的感觉，顿时就令赵大柱心神荡漾，忍不住一阵哆嗦。
“瞧你那样，摸摸我的手，你就受不了了？”
李玉娇嗤笑着说道。
赵大柱终于回过神来，抽手问道：“玉娇你这是怎么了？难道王建国家暴你了？”
此话一出，李玉娇的眼圈顿时微微泛红，眼睛里也起了一层水雾。
“你都猜到了，还问什么？”
李玉娇揉揉眼睛说道，声音里夹着一丝哭腔。
“王建国真不是个东西，有你这么好看的老婆居然不珍惜。”
赵大柱忍不住说道，而且越想越气。
王建国身为杏花村的村长，恶事做尽，在村子里不是欺负这个就是收拾那个。
赵大柱也被王建国欺负过很多次，可以说是饱受屈辱。

甚至就连房子，田地，也都被王建国巧取豪夺的霸占了！
赵大柱不止一次的想和王建国拼命，但他最后都忍了下来。
因为拼不过！
他都年过半百了，而且还是光棍，无儿无女。
可王建国呢？
人家身强力壮，还有一大堆小混混狗腿子为他办事，他跟人家拼命的资格都没有！
他心里恨呐，可他又能怎么样呢？
李玉娇吸了吸鼻子，说道：“赵老头你别磨蹭了，你快摸我，不管你想对我做什么都行……王建国不当人，那么欺负你，你现在弄他的女人，就是对他最好的报复！”
说话间，李玉娇还往赵大柱的跟前靠近，她那鼓鼓囊囊的胸脯都快贴到赵大柱的身上了。
从她身上散发出的脂粉气，赵大柱也能清清楚楚的闻到。
赵大柱忍不住深吸一口，顿时心神荡漾，甚至还有种口干舌燥的感觉。
见赵大柱喉头滚动吞咽口水，李玉娇就知道这个老头肯定是有那心思了，于是她就咬咬牙准备解开衣服扣子。
赵大柱却惊慌失措的抓住她的手腕阻止道：“玉娇，你别这样，王建国不是人，可你是个好女人，你不能这么作贱自己。”
“你别劝我，也不要拦我，我当初就不想嫁给王建国，他吃喝嫖赌，还一次又一次的打我，他根本就不是人……”李玉娇带着哭腔说道。
“可这里不是干那种事的地方啊，万一被村里人看见，就真的麻烦大了。”赵大柱慌乱的说道。
content_en:
"Old man Zhao, I know you have been bullied by the Wang family all your life. Now if you want to take revenge, I can help you!"
"I'm not lying to you. I am Wang Jianguo's wife. If you touch me, you are retaliating against him. Do you understand?"
"Why are you still standing there stupidly? Come on and touch me. I've already taken the initiative. Why are you, a grown man, so nagging?"
On the farmland of Xinghua Village, Zhao Dazhu stared blankly at Li Yujiao in front of him, unable to recover for a moment.
He is fifty-two years old this year. Let alone doing that kind of thing with a woman, he has never even touched a woman's little hand. Until now, he is still a bachelor and is laughed at by the villagers.
The Li Yujiao in front of her was the wife of Wang Jianguo, the head of Xinghua Village. She was young and beautiful, less than thirty years old, with fair skin, big eyes that seemed to be able to talk, and a pink and tender cherry mouth that made people want to stop looking at her.
She also has a very good figure. She usually goes out to buy groceries or something. When the old and young men in the village see her, who doesn't laugh?
But now she actually came to her door and threw herself into the arms of an old bachelor like herself?
Zhao Dazhu was still in a daze, but Li Yujiao couldn't wait any longer and took the initiative to grab Zhao Dazhu's calloused hand.
The smooth and delicate touch, as well as the soft and boneless feeling, immediately made Zhao Dazhu's heart flutter, and he couldn't help but shiver.
"Look at you like that, can't you bear to touch my hand?"
Li Yujiao said with a sneer.
Zhao Dazhu finally came to his senses, pulled out his hand and asked: "Yujiao, what's wrong with you? Did Wang Jianguo rape you?"
As soon as these words came out, Li Yujiao's eye circles suddenly turned slightly red, and a layer of mist formed in her eyes.
"You've already guessed it, why do you ask?"
Li Yujiao rubbed her eyes and said with a hint of crying in her voice.
"Wang Jianguo is really nothing. He doesn't cherish such a beautiful wife like you."
Zhao Dazhu couldn't help but said, and the more he thought about it, the more angry he became.
As the head of Xinghua Village, Wang Jianguo has done all sorts of evil things. He either bullies some or punishes others in the village.
Zhao Dazhu was also bullied many times by Wang Jianguo, and it can be said that he suffered humiliation.
Even the houses and fields were occupied by Wang Jianguo by clever means!
Zhao Dazhu wanted to fight Wang Jianguo more than once, but he endured it in the end.
Because I can’t fight!
He is over fifty years old, and he is still a bachelor with no children.
But what about Wang Jianguo?
He is strong and strong, and there are a lot of gangsters working for him. He is not qualified to fight with them!
He hated it in his heart, but what could he do?
Li Yujiao sniffed and said: "Old Zhao, please stop dawdling, touch me quickly, no matter what you want to do to me...Wang Jianguo is not a human being, so he bullied you, and you messing with his woman now is the best revenge for him!"
While talking, Li Yujiao moved closer to Zhao Dazhu, and her bulging breasts were almost pressed against Zhao Dazhu's body.
Zhao Dazhu could also clearly smell the powdery smell emanating from her body.
Zhao Dazhu couldn't help but take a deep breath, and suddenly his heart was filled with excitement, and he even felt like his mouth was dry.
Seeing Zhao Dazhu's throat rolling and swallowing, Li Yujiao knew that the old man must have had that in mind, so she gritted her teeth and prepared to unbutton her clothes.
However, Zhao Dazhu panicked and grabbed her wrist to stop him: "Yujiao, don't do this. Wang Jianguo is not a human being, but you are a good woman. You can't debase yourself like this."
"Don't persuade me, don't stop me. I didn't want to marry Wang Jianguo in the first place. He was eating, drinking, whoring, gambling, and beating me again and again. He is not a human being at all..." Li Yujiao said with a tearful voice.
"But this is not the place to do that kind of thing. If someone in the village sees it, it will be really troublesome." Zhao Dazhu said in a panic.
